MITMList_Description: Regex-matched entries that override the global SSL inspection toggle. Lower priority value wins. Filter entries MITM and inspect, Passthrough entries bypass MITM entirely, Blackhole entries drop the connection with a block page.
MITMList_NoMatch: No entry matches this host — falls through to the global toggle.
MITMList_PriorityHelp: Lower number = higher precedence. Ties resolved by creation time.
MITMList_RegexHelp: Case-insensitive regex matched against the host (e.g. .*\.example\.com)
